title: In-memory message broker
prompt:
Implement `Send(topic string, msg []byte)` and `Receive(ctx context.Context, topic string) ([]byte, error)` on `Broker`.

- Messages sent before any reader waits are kept, in FIFO order per topic.
- Every message goes to exactly one receiver, with many goroutines sending and receiving.
- `Receive` blocks until a message arrives, or returns `ctx.Err()` when `ctx` is done.
hint: Queue per topic under a mutex; wake waiters by closing a `ready` channel and making a new one.
